# AMASS 已统一人体动作格式，是否可以直接作为人形机器人动作跟踪标签？

> **当前答案：** AMASS v1 统一的是 15 个 marker-based 动捕数据集的人体 SMPL-H 表示；它不检查目标机器人关节、接触、碰撞、力矩或闭环可跟踪性。因此工程上应把 AMASS 保留为人体源层，再经过机器人专用重定向与动力学闭环筛选后才形成训练标签。

## 关键术语

- 惯性测量单元（Inertial Measurement Unit, IMU）
- 关节力矩（Joint Torque）
- 动作重定向（Motion Retargeting）
- 动作跟踪（Motion Tracking）
- 动力学（Dynamics）

## 适用机器人

- Humanoid platforms receiving motions retargeted from human data

## 适用模拟器

- Any simulator used for downstream closed-loop feasibility checks

## 控制器与方法

- motion-retargeting pipelines
- motion-tracking policy data pipelines

## 适用环境

- offline human-motion preprocessing
- robot-specific simulation filtering

## 成立假设

- The source sequences are licensed AMASS/SMPL-H records with explicit model versions.
- Robot retargeting and closed-loop feasibility filtering are implemented as separate downstream stages.

## 结果

- AMASS v1 统一的是 15 个 marker-based 动捕数据集的人体 SMPL-H 表示；它不检查目标机器人关节、接触、碰撞、力矩或闭环可跟踪性。因此工程上应把 AMASS 保留为人体源层，再经过机器人专用重定向与动力学闭环筛选后才形成训练标签。

## 限制

- The source sequences are licensed AMASS/SMPL-H records with explicit model versions.
- Robot retargeting and closed-loop feasibility filtering are implemented as separate downstream stages.

## 证据

- [AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes](<https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.03278v1>) — `support/primary`；Sections 1-3 and Figures 2, 6, and 9；Defines the marker-to-SMPL-H reconstruction scope and validates human surface reconstruction, not robot tracking feasibility.
- [nghorbani/amass official tools](<https://github.com/nghorbani/amass/tree/a9888a92a4e62533454aa43e5f979d9a8bc8c893>) — `support/primary`；prepare_data.py: dump_amass2pytroch, AMASS_Augment, prepare_amass; dfaust_synthetic_mocap.py: registration2markers at a9888a9；Shows official data preparation and synthetic-marker tools without a robot URDF, contact, torque, or closed-loop controller gate.
